resume: MYCELIUM is a Forest, Psytrance, Goa and Hitech groovebox built on SLOOP and Felucca: three synths and a drum machine, six factory grooves and four songs. Each button has two lives: tapped, it opens its pages; held, a layer where the white keys and knobs change role.

commandes.role: Synths: octave down (both: back to 0). Drums, held: ghost hits. With EDIT held: undo.
Synths: octave up. Drums, held: strong hits. With EDIT held: redo. In menus: confirm.
Tapped: PSY FX (1 KB LP the low-pass of the bass and kick, 2 SPACE echo and reverb, 3 FB+DRV, 4 ALIEN+ ring and stutter on the lead and FX). Held: the punch layer, one effect per white key.
Called SCL. Held: the key layer, a key gives the song's key; KNOB 1 the chord, 2 the scale, 3 the keys, 4 the transposition.
Tapped: the envelope (on track 1 the bass, on track 4 the kick's). Held 0.7 s, beat running: a temporary psy fill of hi-hats and claps.
Tapped: the modulation. Held 0.7 s: the FOREST, GOA, HITECH patterns of the lead and FX, in turn.
Held: the erase layer, a key erases that sound or note from the pattern; KNOB 1 shifts, 2 doubles or cuts, 3 transposes.
Held: the mix layer, keys 1 to 4 mute, 5 to 8 solo, the last one tap tempo; KNOB 1 to 4 the track volume. GLO > SYSTEM > SYNC: USB, TRS or INT.
The tracks screen. Held: the menu (GROOVES, SONGS, color, lights, logo). Tapped while a layer is held: locks it.
Tapped: the four factory songs, or USER SONG. Held: the song layer, keys 1 to 4 play sections A to D, 5 to 8 save the loop there.
Tapped: the next bass pattern, GALLOP, OFFBEAT, FULL-ON. Held: roll, the held note repeats on the grid; held 0.7 s, the roll stays.
Held: the step layer, the white keys are the steps of the page; KNOB 1 sound or note, 2 DIV, 3 swing, 4 length.
Starts and stops the four tracks, also inside a layer.
While playing: records right away, or stops. When stopped: arms, the first note starts. Held: erases the selected track (a ring fills).
Volume.
The tempo, always, even in a layer.
The track's sound, or the drum kit.
Chooses the track, on every page.
Play the track: on the drums, 16 sounds. In a held layer, their role changes (effects, steps, key, mute and solo, sections).
On the drums, the sound of the white key to their left.

gestes: A button held + HOME tapped: its layer stays open (LOCK), both hands free; another button closes it.
HOME held > GROOVES, a groove, OCT+ then OCT+: loads one of the six 32-step grooves (FOREST JAM, PSY ROLL, PSY GALLOP, GOA ACID, HITECH, TEKK); a key played starts the beat.
HOME held > SONGS: Forest Odyssey, Psy Ascension, Tekk Reactor, Hitech Portal, four songs of 240 bars.

modes.texte: Tracks 1 to 3: the synths (1 the bass), track 4: the drums. On the tracks screen, KNOB 1 sets the probability of tracks 2 and 3; KNOB 4 the distortion of the bass and drums, the pan of the synths.

a_savoir: Loading a groove replaces the current loop and its sounds: save first.
USB and TRS MIDI: channels 1 to 3 the synths, 10 the drums, 4 the selected track; notes, velocity, clock, start and stop.
